+@pytest.mark.parametrize('am, stdin', [({'mode': {}}, {})], indirect=['am', 'stdin'])
+def test_new_file_mode_on_disk(am, tmp_path):
+    src = tmp_path / 'source'
+    dest = tmp_path / 'dest'
+    src.write_text('secret')
+    os.chmod(str(src), 0o644)
+    am.selinux_enabled = lambda: False
+
+    previous_umask = os.umask(0o022)
+    try:
+        am.atomic_move(str(src), str(dest))
+    finally:
+        os.umask(previous_umask)
+
+    assert stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(str(dest)).st_mode) == 0o600
+    assert am._created_files == {str(dest)}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('am, stdin, tracked', [
+    ({'mode': {}}, {}, True),
+    ({'mode': {}}, {'mode': '0640'}, False),
+    ({}, {}, False),
+], indirect=['am', 'stdin'])
+def test_created_file_warning_depends_on_mode_option(atomic_am, atomic_mocks, mocker, capfd, tracked):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.common.warnings._global_warnings', [])
+    atomic_mocks['path_exists'].return_value = False
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/path/to/src', '/path/to/dest')
+
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == ({'/path/to/dest'} if tracked else set())
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        atomic_am.exit_json()
+
+    result = json.loads(capfd.readouterr()[0])
+    warning = "File '/path/to/dest' created with default permissions '600'. The previous default was '666'. Specify 'mode' to avoid this warning."
+    assert result.get('warnings', []) == ([warning] if tracked else [])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('am, stdin', [({'mode': {}}, {})], indirect=['am', 'stdin'])
+def test_setting_mode_removes_only_that_created_file_warning(atomic_am, atomic_mocks, mocker, capfd):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.common.warnings._global_warnings', [])
+    atomic_mocks['path_exists'].return_value = False
+    atomic_mocks['umask'].side_effect = [0o022, 0, 0o022, 0]
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/path/to/src1', '/path/to/dest1')
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/path/to/src2', '/path/to/dest2')
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == {'/path/to/dest1', '/path/to/dest2'}
+
+    mocker.patch('os.lstat', return_value=mocker.Mock(st_mode=0o600))
+    atomic_am.set_mode_if_different('/path/to/dest1', None, False)
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == {'/path/to/dest1', '/path/to/dest2'}
+    atomic_am.set_mode_if_different('/path/to/dest1', '0600', False)
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == {'/path/to/dest2'}
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        atomic_am.exit_json()
+    result = json.loads(capfd.readouterr()[0])
+    assert result['warnings'] == [
+        "File '/path/to/dest2' created with default permissions '600'. The previous default was '666'. Specify 'mode' to avoid this warning."
+    ]
